source.license_summary: non-commercial research and educational use under the PartNet-Mobility and ShapeNet terms

selection.ranking_rule: within each exact package category, ascending SHA256(dataset_id UTF-8), then dataset_id; take first six
selection.failure_policy: retain every frozen selection in the requested denominator; never replace unavailable, parse-failed, invalid, or unscorable assets

evaluation.same_ontology_provenance_warning: PartNet-Mobility package semantics and the PartNet-derived ontology share provenance; annotation-assisted results are calibration only, not independent correctness evidence.

claim_boundary.dataset_role: curated real-data reference, not a generation method and excluded from generated-method rankings
claim_boundary.structure: package-level URDF structural validity and representation diagnostics
claim_boundary.ontology: PartNet-ontology-referenced induced hierarchy alignment; not instance-level kinematic hierarchy correctness
claim_boundary.source_authentication: official repository identity and terms are pinned, but selected local bytes remain provenance-limited unless directly matched to official-revision object bytes
